section.title: Engineering AI in the enterprise
section.description: Hands-on experience building Generative AI, Agentic AI and full-stack AI solutions across enterprise use cases.

journey.description: Completed intensive AIML-focused training and transitioned into enterprise AI engineering.
Worked across enterprise AI initiatives involving Generative AI, Agentic AI and intelligent automation.
Working in an AI Engineering role focused on designing and developing enterprise AI solutions.

experience.summary: Build and contribute to enterprise AI applications spanning RAG, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, AI governance and full-stack AI engineering.

highlights.title: Generative AI & RAG
highlights.description: Build retrieval-augmented generation pipelines covering document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounded citations and evaluation.

highlights.title: Agentic AI
highlights.description: Develop stateful agentic workflows using LangGraph with multi-agent orchestration, routing, tool and function calling, memory/state, human-in-the-loop interaction, retries, error handling and self-correction.

highlights.title: AI Backend Engineering
highlights.description: Develop Python and FastAPI services using Pydantic and SQLAlchemy, with PostgreSQL, pgvector and OpenSearch supporting AI application and retrieval layers.

highlights.title: Full-Stack AI Applications
highlights.description: Integrate AI backends with React, TypeScript, Vite and Tailwind-based interfaces, including conversational chat experiences and streaming responses.

highlights.title: Enterprise AI Workflows
highlights.description: Contribute to requirement-to-gap identification, test generation and implementation pipelines, HR onboarding automation, AI governance and parts cross-sell/upsell workflows.

highlights.title: Architecture & Engineering
highlights.description: Contribute across solution architecture, implementation, integration, debugging, technical demonstrations and end-to-end AI application development.

workstreams.name: Requirement & Testing Intelligence
workstreams.description: Agentic pipeline for requirement-to-gap identification, test generation and implementation.

workstreams.name: HR Onboarding Automation
workstreams.description: AI-driven onboarding workflow integrating enterprise systems including ServiceNow and Workday.

workstreams.name: Agentic Governance Platform
workstreams.description: Enterprise-oriented platform for governing and managing agentic AI workflows.

workstreams.name: Parts Cross-Sell & Upsell
workstreams.description: Agentic workflow supporting intelligent parts cross-sell and upsell automation.
